look_here_first: Recognize narrow grasslike basal leaves and a stalk of small cream to greenish-white six-tepaled flowers; closely examine tepals, stamens and ovary. Do not mistake it for an edible Allium.
photo_note: Temporary one-photo learner coverage. Keep until stronger diagnostic gallery coverage replaces or supplements it.
identification_caution: Poisonous; do not sample or encourage handling/eating. Arkansas image provenance, not Hays native-range evidence.
